Hank Cicalo’s career as a recording engineer has spanned over fifty years. His expertise contributed to the success of artists including Carole King, George Harrison, Tom Scott, Cannonball Adderley and the Monkees. Hank was a first- call engineer for major labels such as Dot Records, A&M, and RCA.
Hank was interviewed via Zoom on April 20, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Hank Cicalo with me today. And I’m going to start out with a statement and see if you agree with it, Hank, and that is for 60-some years you’ve had one of the coolest jobs possible.
